keyword.en: integrated mixer pump 45 kW and 14 kW
keyword.zh: 搅拌泵一体机45千瓦和14千瓦怎么分

title.en: How the Integrated Mixer Splits Motor Power
title.zh: 搅拌泵一体机怎样拆分电机功率

description.en: The electric mixer prints main motor 45 kW and mixer motor 14 kW. Those are two names on one line, not two outputs.
description.zh: 电动搅拌泵印主电机 45 kW 和搅拌电机 14 kW。这是一行里的两个名称，不是两个产量。

h1.en: How the Integrated Mixer Splits Motor Power
h1.zh: 搅拌泵一体机怎样拆分电机功率

directAnswer.en: The integrated mixer is a concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai with two motors on one line: main motor 45 kW and mixer motor 14 kW. Theoretical output is 21 m³/h, not 45 and not 59. Outlet pressure is 23 MPa and distance is 100 m / 300 m. The second motor is named as the mixer motor. The page does not call it a second pumping motor, and it does not print a second output for mixing.
directAnswer.zh: 搅拌泵一体机是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，一行里有两台电机：主电机 45 kW，搅拌电机 14 kW。理论输送量是 21 m³/h，不是 45，也不是 59。出口压力 23 MPa，距离 100 m / 300 m。第二台电机被命名为搅拌电机。页面没有把它叫做第二台泵送电机，也没有为搅拌单印一个产量。

heading.en: The slash on the power line

body.en: The cell is labelled main motor / mixer motor and the value is 45 kW / 14 kW. Keep both numbers with their names. Adding them into one 59 kW pumping figure is not what Hebei Pinjin Machinery printed.
body.zh: 这一格的标题是主电机/搅拌电机，数值是 45 kW / 14 kW。两个数字都要和名称留在一起。把它们加成 59 kW 的泵送功率，不是河北品锦机械印出的内容。

body.en: 21 m³/h is the theoretical output. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. Pipe diameter is 100 / 125 mm. Aggregate is 4 cm and below. None of those cells is split into a main figure and a mixer figure.
body.zh: 21 m³/h 是理论输送量。料斗 0.4 m³。管径 100 / 125 mm。骨料 4 cm 及以下。这些格子都没有拆成主数字和搅拌数字。

heading.en: Compared with a pump-only motor line
heading.zh: 和只泵送的电机行相比

body.en: Electric 40 prints one motor, 45 kW, and output 21 m³/h, without a 14 kW mixer motor. Similar output does not make it a mixer. The mixer page is the one with two named motors.
body.zh: 电动40只印一台电机 45 kW，产量 21 m³/h，没有 14 kW 搅拌电机。产量相近也不会使它变成搅拌泵。有两台被点名电机的，才是搅拌泵这一页。

answer.en: The page names it the mixer motor.
answer.zh: 页面把它命名为搅拌电机。

answer.en: No. Output is 21 m³/h. 45 kW is the main motor.
answer.zh: 不是。产量是 21 m³/h。45 kW 是主电机。

question.en: Does the mixer motor have its own distance?
question.zh: 搅拌电机有自己的距离吗？

answer.en: No. Distance is printed once: 100 m / 300 m.
answer.zh: 没有。距离只印一次：100 m / 300 m。

answer.en: No. Electric 40 does not print a 14 kW mixer motor.
answer.zh: 不是。电动40没有印 14 kW 搅拌电机。
